requiredFindings.title: Separate content length from path length and price every owned native-name representation
requiredFindings.description: B_launch uses len(m) both in env(len(m)) for file reads and in the composed launch path allocation. In LAW item 4 len(f) is the authenticated content byte length; the launch-path expression instead needs the final row path byte length. These are independent, including for an empty file with a nonempty path, so the same quantity cannot establish both bounds. The recipe also prices fopen only as an open plus st and binding only as st, while the proposed component_tree helpers explicitly leave copied native names/paths to caller-owned records. open_regular_no_follow constructs a NUL-terminated basename; a path-based lstat/fstatat needs a suitable native spelling too. The single output-path allocation does not establish that these additional representations or their terminators are funded. CI-A3-d additionally introduces an owned store path without stating its charge site/bound. Thus the claimed complete conservative accounting is not yet established. The h definition also incorrectly calls the number of resolution lookups a property of the final row and does not give explicit lookup/hop counts for the special root-directory request.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Define distinct quantities for authenticated file content length, final path byte length, basename length, and the actual resolution lookup/hop counts. Use content length for the read envelope and path length for path construction. Specify the native spelling/result representation and charge all allocations and terminators before they occur, either separately or through an explicitly shared representation that avoids the copies. State where the store absolute-path record is charged once at opening, separately from per-launch charges. Define Directory("") with no index lookup or hop and no negative counts. Keep all arithmetic checked and make the reference bound conservative without conflating actual counts with precomputed maxima.
requiredFindings.validationExpectation: Extend CI-T28 with zero-length files under long paths, large files under short paths, nested and multi-hop paths whose intermediate lengths differ from the final length, and Directory(""). Independently enumerate native basename/path copies, output storage and the one-time store-path record, including terminators where present. Require the modeled bound to dominate all actual charges and one-unit-short refusal before each allocation/read/status operation; do not merely compare charge calls with the same cost functions.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Identify the absolute-path identity observation required by the binding
nonBlockingObservations.description: P-7 exposes a price, not the binding observation itself. In the permitted CI-2 candidate, component_tree::entry_status accepts one slash-free component relative to a retained directory and returns EntryStatus {kind, mode, length}, without device/inode. sample_identity observes an opened TreeFile, not the absolute spelling. Neither directly supplies the specified absolute-path comparison. The statement that no platform primitive is added should not imply that this operation is already exposed.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: In CI-3L scope, name the owner and API for the one no-follow-final absolute-path status observation, including identity, error partition and before-call charge. It may use the existing st price, with the owned spelling costs corrected under RF-1; describe any required platform helper/exposure accurately. Keep this mechanism change in CI-3L rather than altering the in-flight CI-2 subject.

rulings.Q1: Accepted. Resolve only over the authenticated TreeCommitment using the security owner's parent-plus-target rule, with the selected entrypoint retained from the same admitted platform association. Bound lookup count by S+1, reject missing/wrong-kind/cyclic or over-bound resolution as Association, and open the final row component by component without following filesystem links. Directory("") is an explicit root special case. The resolved committed member has no symlink ancestor because security validates every row parent as a dir. This does not prove that ambient ancestors of the absolute store path can never be changed; those remain in the stated custody/residual model. No allocating seen-set is required if the bounded hop rule is used.
rulings.Q2: Accepted as an instantaneous binding under the disclosed residual, subject to the operation and price details in RF-1/NBO-1. Compare kind and device/inode from a no-follow-final observation of the exact composed absolute launch spelling with those from the member opened under the retained base. A symlink final component or a different object is Binding even when its bytes match. Keep true observation Io and Budget distinct. Define absent/not-directory outcomes explicitly at the implementation seam rather than collapsing every native error into Binding. Binding is promised-tree corruption: operational-failed 4, HOST.IO_FAILURE, DELIVERY.CLOSURE_BYTES_CORRUPT durably and no detail ephemerally. The pin prevents lawful GC, not same-principal writes. The residual disclosure is consistent with LAW item 5 and M3-D item 2.
rulings.Q3: No D1a amendment is required for this selected model. M3-D item 2 already places the closure-owner recheck immediately before handover to D1, says D1 adds no second digest recipe, and expressly discloses a same-user substitution between recheck and exec. A second device/inode sample immediately before posix_spawn narrows but does not close that window; it is not a substitute for the charged closure-owner recheck or a new claim of exclusive custody. If later selected, it needs its own owned platform change, accounting and controls. CI-A3 should not claim to close the residual through either a pin or a repeated sample.
rulings.Q4: Accepted within the same lawful-immutability and trusted-same-principal model. A retained-tree open has verified the full contents; for a directory launch argument, a fresh no-follow directory/type/mode/identity observation plus absolute-path binding and the operation's retained pin is sufficient here. A directory inode or flock does not attest unchanged descendant bytes against a same-user writer; do not describe it that way. Files individually named by the launch spec still get their own rehashes, and all relevant closure pins stay held through child settlement. Directory("") uses the retained tree handle and its bound absolute spelling, with an explicit special-case price.
rulings.Q5: Not yet accepted as a complete conservative recipe: RF-1 is required. The intended lookup, hop, descent, file-open/read, directory-status, binding and result rows are appropriate, and the retained buffer and fixed stack SHA state need not be charged again. However content length, path length, actual hops and upper-bound hops must be distinct; native names/path storage and the one-time store path must be accounted for. CI-T28 must enumerate these independently. Reusing read_verified is coherent with LAW's read-attempt envelope and fixed-stack hash state; this review does not impose a new hash price absent from that law.
rulings.Q6: Accepted. CI-3L should be a separate lifecycle unit after CI-2/CI-3 integrates, using that integrated main, with changed-path guards. It owns the new launch operation, store-path representation, Binding type and their controls, plus any needed platform exposure. Do not mutate the in-flight CI-2/CI-3 review subject or treat CI-A2 as accepted here. CI-A2 index/search changes require rebasing this amendment if their accepted interface or prices differ. D4-4 must depend on CI-A3 acceptance and CI-3L implementation/integration, not merely CI-3 plus accepted text. The scope should cover CI-A3-e/f as well as a-d.
